units: image, image-condition pool, actual subset, permutation-prefix state; never independent people
N: all eligible independent voters of declared pool; no quality or GT filtering
k2: node identities/votes retained, ordering and full quality deferred
R: mean source floor pair symmetric difference h^2 and divided by fixed full-pool source union; valid/possible pairs retained
V: actual output 1-IoU and symmetric difference; overlap and identical subset retained
quality: same_target and all current source quality_usable; main additionally excludes original holdout and restricted/OOS layers
diagnostic: raw WQ/IoU3D and diagnostic_B8L2/D10 include diagnostics; OOS never quality
time: source active seconds only, all member coverage required; not target-adjusted time
reference: declared current target independent of outcome; never select highest score
missing: empty is missing not zero; below-four, no connection, reference and input failures retained
completion: DONE per pool only after all declared paths and state outputs written; STATUS may be partial
composition: subset_composition.csv uses target-building-excluded ordinary Manual profiles; classification_metric distinct from output score metric
worker_comparisons: priority entry policies not necessarily pure-type teams; supported focus and actual Q/T counts required; coverage table retains failed or unavailable outputs
same_room: common-people prefixes/endpoint, not whole-image all-person pool; identical canonical order on both sides; no cross-view geometry intersection
boolean: parse CSV True/False explicitly; blank is not positive holdout; legacy 71 holdout objects retained
correction: holdout_flag_correction.json affects main comparison mask only, not geometry or numeric scores
measurement_cache: pools/<pool>/score_cache.json: context + complete measurements by subset. No reuse with changed reference/input; unknown future measurement fields retained.
field_recovery: measurement_field_recovery.csv key pool_id/subset/field. Each value has matching-context source; old tables/source snapshots in pre_revision_tables.zip.
random_main: random_8to16_main_panel.csv is 27 images passing existing main_comparison_allowed at both paired quality endpoints; three holdouts remain descriptive.
V_availability: V_pairs_from/to and V_valid_pair_ids_from/to report endpoint availability; V_strict_* uses the identical replay-pair intersection at both k. No V imputation.
